fields.description: Users can create multiple Job Offers directly from the Job Applicant list using the Actions menu.
fields.label: Allow Bulk Job Offer Creation

fields.description: Users can send Job Offer emails to multiple candidates at once from the Job Offer list using the Actions menu.
fields.label: Allow Bulk Job Offer Email

fields.description: Show the "Send Pre Offer Form" button on the Job Applicant form and the bulk action in the Job Applicant list. When unticked, the button/action is hidden for everyone.
fields.label: Enable Pre Offer Form Button

fields.description: Show the "Send Pre Onboarding Form" button on the Job Applicant form and the Job Offer form. When unticked, the button is hidden for everyone.
fields.label: Enable Pre Onboarding Form Button

fields.description: Default Print Format used for the candidate-facing Job Offer page and PDF download. Used as a fallback when no employment-type-specific format is mapped below.
fields.label: Job Offer Print Format

fields.description: Pick the Job Offer Print Format per Employment Type (Intern, Trainee, Employee, ...). When a row matches the applicant's Employment Type it is used; otherwise the default "Job Offer Print Format" above is used.
fields.label: Job Offer Print Format by Employment Type

fields.description: Select the roles that are permitted to submit interview feedback even if they are not listed as interviewers for the round.
fields.label: Authorized Roles for Feedback Submission

fields.description: Employee statuses allowed when selecting the "Replacement For" employee on a Job Requisition position. When a position's posting detail is a Replacement, only employees with one of these statuses are shown. Falls back to "Active" only when left empty.
fields.label: Allowed Replacement Employee Statuses
